rule_name: Volume shadow copies and backup catalogue deleted

process.name: cmd.exe
process.command_line: cmd.exe /c vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet & wbadmin delete catalog -quiet & bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No & wevtutil cl Security

labels.why: Three separate recovery mechanisms destroyed in one command line, with the confirmation prompt suppressed, then the Security log cleared. Freeing disk space touches one of these; a sweep of all of them is ransomware clearing the way before it encrypts.
